_comment: SPU images that are position-independent plugins: FMOD Ex's SPU mixer DMAs them into its
local store wherever it has room and branches in. They are lifted with spu_lifter.py
--relocatable at their link address and dispatched displaced (spu_overlay_register_relocatable).
Selection: every embedded SPU ELF linked at LS 0x80 except the two mixers (entry 0xF0,
spu_0005/spu_0006, which run as SPU thread images at their link address).
Observed displaced so far: spu_0008 (codec, entry 0x218) at LS 0x156F0 (delta 0x15670).
A relocatable lift of an image that does run at its link address behaves the same (delta 0).
tools/pipeline.py computes each image's source EA (its executable segment in the EBOOT).
